title: Plan-only release distillation planner from task records
goal: First slice of release distillation (board item 113 step 2 input, owned by Dot): `xtask --bin distill -- plan` reads task records at a Git revision, computes the deps closure, checks status, provenance (closed.commit ancestry or Task: trailers) and evidence, reports scope overlaps, and emits a deterministic included/deferred/rejected manifest. Changes no branch; composition, conflict resolution, accept.cmd runs and qualification are explicitly not implemented.
acceptance: cargo test --offline --locked -p xtask --bin distill passes; strict clippy and fmt pass; a real plan of v0.21.52..v0.21.53 runs and its differences are recorded.
base_note: worktree created at origin/main 57dfb2e78, fast-forwarded to 8509b7a8a before claiming (no conflicts; none of the new commits touch this scope)

claim.note: First attempt with a push-policy binary built before 849b0b4b6 failed ('claimed concurrently'); after rebuilding push-policy from 8509b7a8a (which accepts refs/claim-generation) the claim succeeded.

dependencies_note: No task dependency. Designed as input for the release-from-task-records step (workspace board item 113, step 2, owner Dot); does not replace it.

guards.architecture_tests: 42 passed, 1 failed: cross_crate_source_mounts_only_decrease (pre-existing crates/susi-harness/tests/native_link.rs mounts, item 118; unrelated to this change)

v0_21_53_reproduction.why: all 15 records still in_progress (or no status) at the tag and at origin/main; T-PEERCHAN-1 and T-PEERSTATUS-1 also blocked by deps
v0_21_53_reproduction.verdict: v0.21.53 is NOT reproducible from task records: shipped tasks are left open, 61/80 commits carry no Task trailer, and scopes miss 57 changed files

results.real_sample: 12 closed done/ tasks with deps at origin/main: closure 18, 18 included, 0 conflicts (records lack scopes, so the plan warns)

limitations: Plan only: no branch composition, conflict resolution, accept.cmd/gate runs, qualification, receipts, tags.
Provenance is commit-level (closed.commit or Task: trailer); it does not verify a task's commits stay within its scope.
Status mapping of free-text historical statuses is heuristic (documented in task.schema.json).
entangled_unselected overlap uses done/ location or a Task: trailer as 'already in base'.
Scopes are optional in history; unscoped tasks cannot be conflict-checked.

provenance.produced_by: Grok Bot executor on the CEO's CachyOS laptop
provenance.new_dependencies: none (std + existing serde_json facade, Apache-2.0 workspace crate)
